name: Qwen Image 2.1 Viggle Turbo — fewer steps
description:
The same Qwen Image 2.1 you already have, with Viggle’s distilled adapter so it needs far fewer sampling steps. Measured on this machine: a clean scene at 12 steps in about 8 s, against about 16 s for the standard bundle at 25.

★ How many steps you need depends on how busy the picture is, and this is the thing to know before using it:
· A single subject or a tight portrait is clean at 4–6 steps (about 3 s) and looks excellent.
· A scene with two or more distinct objects — an apple AND a glass — needs about 12. Below that the model draws several overlapping transparent copies of each object: ghosting. It is obvious when it happens.
· If a result comes back ghosted, raise the steps and run again. 12 fixed every case tested here, and 25 is always clean.

This is a preview distillation, and that ghosting is its documented weakness on compositional prompts — not something a different prompt wording fixes. For a complex scene that has to be right, use the standard Qwen Image 2.1 bundle.

Prompt it exactly like the base model: full sentences, and any words you want rendered in "quotes" with a note on where they go.
